rationale: DOI:10.1002/cbic.201000672 reports targeted cpaH inactivation in native Aspergillus oryzae and loss of 2-oxocyclopiazonic acid production; the evidence demonstrates the BGC0000977 locus.

PMID:20536237 reports in vitro incubation of recombinant Streptomyces avermitilis SAV_76 with farnesyl diphosphate to form avermitilol; the evidence demonstrates the BGC0000683 locus without upgrading the native producer claim.

DOI:10.1021/ja111279h reports recombinant Streptomyces arenae PntM converting pentalenolactone F to pentalenolactone and native pntM deletion blocking pentalenolactone production; the evidence demonstrates the BGC0000653 locus and native producer claim.
PMID:11562468 reconstitutes Stigmatella AF299336.1 MxcE/MxcF/MxcG-dependent myxochelin A formation in vitro; the evidence demonstrates this locus without upgrading the native producer claim.
